LEGACY_BF16.backbone: legacy CUDA BF16 autocast; FP32 stable suboperations retained

FP32_REFERENCE.autocast: CUDA and caller CPU autocast explicitly disabled
FP32_REFERENCE.key_floating_path: coordinate embedding, role/Geo fusion, time/count, modulation, norm/attention/MLP, hidden, readout/addition, final head actually float32 on instrumented calls
FP32_REFERENCE.observed_output: torch.float32; not a final BF16-to-FP32 relabel

readout.on: Four original learned residuals at blocks3/6/9/12
readout.off: Return unchanged hidden at only those four extra apply_readout sites; branch computation skipped
readout.zero: Compute true branch/cast, add torch.zeros_like(cast) at same site; no parameter mutation
readout.clean: Fresh known H0 after coordinate+role+Geo in the same forward, not detached or cross-step cached
readout.mixed: Known hidden at the corresponding original block output

unchanged.attention_backend: same math SDPA; no FlashAttention switch
unchanged.prediction: native velocity; no extra x1/velocity conversion
unchanged.integration: x_free + velocity_free.float()*(1/50), original C written unchanged
unchanged.parameters_and_rng: Saved preflight/fixed-state cryptographic integrity receipts unchanged, no optimizer constructed

numerical_gate.scope: B/C x first P1/P2 x t=.5. This preserves default behavior in those four tested legacy fixtures, not a universal bitwise proof.

interpretation: OFF is not unconditional, A or START: the backbone was jointly trained with readout.
Changes under FP32_OFF measure backbone precision effects; ON/OFF interaction includes the full precision pathway.
Larger branch differences or more faithfully represented additions do not prove useful condition integration or better geometry.
Complete rollout and visual/geometry results are separate evidence and are not judged by this dtype contract.
